name: Shigley Example 8-1, square thread
purpose: Textbook validation. A 25 mm square thread, 5 mm pitch, single start, raising 6.4 kN with thread and collar friction of 0.08 on a 40 mm collar. Shigley 10th ed. gives T_R = 21.16 N*m, T_L = 10.9 N*m and 24.1 percent efficiency. Nut, column and speed checks are switched off so this isolates the torque model.
